family.geometry: D_m bipyramid around fixed terminals N,S

metrics: number of symmetry-equivalent ancilla slots m
replacement spares after reserving four active channels: max(m-4,0)
reference_reason_for_four_channels: the frozen tri-tetra/firewall geometry has four hub-to-shell cut interfaces; no physical identification of those interfaces with the fiber is assumed in this benchmark
winner_rule: report Pareto front over minimum kappa and maximum slot/spare count; separately report the unique integer m with minimum kappa
claim_rule: geometric redundancy/uniformity only; no coupling-strength, crosstalk, loss, or hardware advantage without a source-bound interaction model
